SHARED-F-1-S170.title: Tool Schema Contract Standardization and Versioning
SHARED-F-1-S170.description: Define and enforce a standardized contract for all tool schemas using Pydantic models, including version tagging and strict field validation to ensure compatibility with the tool router.

SHARED-F-1-S171.title: Allowlist Registry Configuration and Loading Mechanism
SHARED-F-1-S171.description: Implement a centralized allowlist registry for all permitted tools, including initialization and runtime loading within the tool router to prevent unauthorized tool execution.

SHARED-F-1-S172.title: Prompt System Integration for Tool Exposure
SHARED-F-1-S172.description: Integrate the allowlisted tool definitions with the prompt system maker to ensure only approved tools are exposed to the LLM during tool-use initialization.

SHARED-F-1-S173.title: Unit Tests for Schema Validation and Allowlist Enforcement
SHARED-F-1-S173.description: Develop unit tests covering valid and invalid tool inputs, schema violations, and allowlist rejection scenarios to ensure strict enforcement behavior.
